pain: Without a versioned entry format and digest chain, a changed, reordered or truncated history cannot be detected.
who: HOME's trusted internal consumers: Collectors that append Activity Events and Projections that replay them.
done_when: LedgerEntry exposes stored comparisonDigest and entryDigest alongside formatVersion, sequence, entryType, previousDigest and payload. entryDigest is lowercase hex SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the five body fields (excluding both digest fields), computed synchronously with node:crypto createHash. verifyHistory recomputes and compares both digests.
The modules in this slice import no storage, cloudflare:workers or Durable Object API.
Committed fixtures include the RFC 8785 test vectors and synthetic ledger entries whose expected digests were produced outside the package; tests read them and never regenerate them.

verifyHistory returns a typed IntegrityFailure for each of sequence_gap, unsupported_format, previous_digest_mismatch, entry_digest_mismatch, comparison_digest_mismatch and trusted_head_mismatch, each covered by a test on in-memory entry arrays.
A truncated tail fails verifyHistory only when a trusted head is supplied, and a test proves both cases.
All fixtures are synthetic, and npm run check passes.

out_of_scope: Live Collectors and Identity Binding config
Projections, Activity Calendar and Project Timeline
Any HOME API, route, MCP server or Scope enforcement
Real customer or account data; fixtures are synthetic
Cloudflare deploys, wrangler login and creating any Cloudflare resource
Merges and paid model spend without Danny's yes
